summary.headline: Bansal Roofing Q1 FY27 revenue rose 26.8% YoY to Rs45.89 crore, with PAT up 31.9% to Rs2.67 crore; solar MMS entry is the next growth lever.
summary.overview: Management described BRPL as an integrated metal building solutions company and, on its maiden call, reported Q1 FY27 revenue of about Rs45.89 crore (up 26.8% YoY) and EBITDA of Rs4.12 crore at roughly 9% margin. Sequentially, revenue was broadly flat versus Q4 FY26 while EBITDA and PAT declined. The quarter saw Rs5 crore of machinery capex, entry into solar module mounting structure (MMS) manufacturing with operations slated for Q2 FY27, and Phase 5 and 6 civil expansion due by mid-September 2026. Management reiterated FY27 revenue projections of about Rs180-190 crore, and disclosed first-time debt of about Rs6 crore.

financial_highlights.change: +26.8% YoY vs Rs36.20 crore; broadly stable QoQ
+35% YoY vs Rs3.01 crore; lower QoQ
Figures cited in a question, not confirmed by management
Company was debt-free in FY26 prior; Rs5 crore term loan for machinery, 4-year repayment

segments.name: Roofing sheets
segments.commentary: FY26 capacity 10,000 TPA with production of 5,072 MT (50.72% utilisation); capacity to rise to 15,000 TPA after expansion.

segments.name: Decking sheets
segments.commentary: Capacity 6,000 TPA; FY26 production 552 MT (9.2% utilisation).

segments.name: Purlins (roll-forming)
segments.commentary: Capacity 1,500 MT; FY26 production 1,278 MT (85.2% utilisation); capacity to rise to 3,600 MT after expansion.

segments.name: PEB structures
segments.commentary: Capacity 9,600 MT; FY26 production 773 MT (80.86% as stated); capacity to rise to 15,000 MT. Management also cited ~1,200 MT/month PEB capacity and ~1,800 MT/month including related components.

segments.name: Solar MMS (new)
segments.commentary: High-speed CU-purlin and HAT roll-forming lines installed; operations to start Q2 FY27. No production yet. Management cited capacity of 25,000 MT/month (may be overstated, to be verified) with gross margin ~4-5% and net margin ~2.5-3%.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue target of about Rs180-190 crore (set in Q4 FY26 investor presentation), with management saying current run-rate is on track; Q2 presentation to detail projections versus actuals.
Management expects solar MMS revenue of about Rs20 crore per month at full run-rate, but said ROCE may fall modestly as solar is lower margin.
Phase 5 and 6 expansion expected complete by mid-September 2026; Phase 6 to add ~200 MT/month of light fabrication PEB capacity.
No further debt planned for current expansion; sandwich panel project (Rs20-30 crore) may be funded via term loan and government subsidy.
capex_capacity: Rs5 crore machinery capex in Q1 FY27: CNC drone forming, CNC plasma cutting, roofing sheet roll forming, overhead and mobile cranes.
Solar MMS lines (CU-purlin and HAT roll formers) installed; recruitment for solar marketing started.
Operating on partial two-shift model (8-12 hours), extendable to 16 hours; management said two-shift could lift capacity 1.75-1.8x, up to ~2,000 tonnes per month.
Rooftop solar increased by 100 kW to ~300 kW; ~45% of electricity met by solar per management.
Unit 2 at Savli, Vadodara, Gujarat: ~3 lakh sq ft built-up on ~7 acres; management said the 3 lakh sq ft premises acquired in 2020 is now fully utilised.
demand_pricing: Order book is about 2 months of revenue; management cited the FY27 target of Rs180-200 crore as implying this cover.
Average order size is Rs3-5 crore; largest recent order was Rs8.5 crore. Last year one order of about Rs24 crore (around 20% of turnover) was from a single party and is near completion.
Solar credit terms expected at 30-45 days, which management said will raise receivable days versus the historically under-two-week level.
Mumbai office is closed after the hired person left; no revenue contribution.

qa_highlights.question: Elaborate on the solar structure opportunity, capacity, top-line and margins.
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited 25,000 MT/month capacity, ~Rs80/kg, implying ~Rs20 crore/month revenue at full run-rate; gross margin ~4-5%, net ~2.5-3%, given bulk supply.

qa_highlights.question: Current PEB capacity and post Phase 5/6 target?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said 1,200 MT/month PEB capacity; two-shift operation could take output to ~2,000 tonnes, not double but 1.75-1.8x.

qa_highlights.question: Current order book and order size?
qa_highlights.answer: About two months of order cover; average order Rs3-5 crore; target Rs180-200 crore for the year.

qa_highlights.question: Is the company taking orders above 10% of revenue?
qa_highlights.answer: Yes, last year one Rs24 crore order (~20% of turnover) from a single party; management said large orders are not regular.

qa_highlights.question: Can ROE of 24% and ROCE of 35% sustain at 25%?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said ROCE may dip slightly as solar scales at lower margins; new debt repayment should lift ROE over time.

qa_highlights.question: Impact of solar business on receivable days?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said solar requires 30-45 day credit, so receivable days will rise.

qa_highlights.question: Are FY27 projections still valid, given new machines?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said it is still on the Rs180-190 crore projection run-rate, considered conservative because solar revenue was not included.

qa_highlights.question: Will capex be funded internally?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said no external funds needed so far; future projects like sandwich panels may use term loans and subsidies.

risks_watch: Solar MMS margins are thin (net ~2.5-3%) and ramp-up is unproven; mix shift could dilute ROCE and EBITDA margin.
Receivable days expected to lengthen from under two weeks to 30-45 days with solar credit terms.
Q1 EBITDA and PAT declined sequentially versus Q4 FY26 despite flat revenue.
Heavy reliance on contract labour (200 of 300 staff) for execution.
Capacity figures for solar (25,000 MT/month) and PEB utilisation (80.86% stated for 773 MT) appear inconsistent and need verification.
Disclosure gap: product-wise breakup and Q1 projections were not in the presentation; management deferred detail to the Q2 presentation.

summary.management_tone: Management sounded confident on the solar MMS opportunity and FY27 run-rate, calling the Rs180-190 crore projection "very conservative". It was cautious and less specific on margins (solar net margin ~2.5-3%, ROCE may dip) and deferred product-wise breakup and Q1 projections to the Q2 presentation.

adds.what: Phase 5 and 6 civil expansion; roofing sheets capacity rising from 10,000 TPA to 15,000 TPA
Solar MMS CU-purlin and HAT roll-forming lines (operations to start Q2 FY27; no production yet)
Phase 6 light fabrication PEB capacity of ~200 MT/month
PEB structures capacity rising from 9,600 MT to 15,000 MT after expansion

growth.why: Management held FY27 revenue guidance at Rs180-200 crore (about 25% growth), backed by a ~2-month order book, Phase 5/6 expansion due mid-September 2026 and solar MMS lines starting Q2 FY27, though solar has no production yet and the 25,000 MT/month capacity figure is unverified.
